title: Astra · controls study v2 pair 1 · keyboard · 1–128

action.intent: Inspect existing buildings before choosing workshop jobs and expanding food, drink, and shelter production.
Move the building-query cursor onto the embark building to inspect it.
Designate nearby trees for cutting to supply the first workshops and beds.
Let dwarves fell the designated trees to supply our first workshops.
Open carpenter workshop placement to establish furniture production.
Place the carpenter's workshop on clear ground near the wagon.
Select an apple log for the carpenter's workshop and let construction proceed.
Leave the build menu and let dwarves construct the carpenter's workshop.
Inspect the carpenter’s workshop and its available jobs.
Open the carpenter's job menu to choose furniture production.
Queue seven beds and three barrels at the carpenter's workshop.
Open placement for a still to establish alcohol production.
Move the still clear of the carpenter and select construction material.
Select willow wood for the still and let construction and carpentry proceed.
Inspect the still and its available workshop jobs.
Inspect a nearby dwarf's labors so someone can construct and operate the still.
Open farming labors for Udib to enable brewing.
Select the farming labor category to assign a brewer.
Enable brewing and plant gathering for Udib.
Leave labor settings and let the newly enabled brewer construct the still.
Exit the labor menu and inspect the next screen before resuming simulation.
Resume simulation so dwarves can build the still and produce queued furniture.
Inspect the still and its available workshop jobs.
Select the still and inspect its available brewing jobs.
Allow the still construction and queued carpentry to progress.
Inspect the completed still and its available workshop jobs.
Add a plant-brewing job and inspect whether the still can run it.
Close the brewing recipe details and inspect the still menu; brewing currently lacks an empty food storage container.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining jobs to secure barrels for brewing.
Let the carpenter finish the remaining beds and brewing barrels.
Inspect the still's brewing options after barrel production has progressed.
Check what still prevents brewing drinks from plants.
Return to the fortress and let the carpenter finish beds and empty barrels needed for brewing.
Inspect the still and available brewing jobs after barrel production.
Check the remaining requirement blocking brewing at the still.
Return from recipe details to inspect the still and carpenter; brewing lacks an empty food storage item.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining jobs and barrel production.
Let the carpenter finish the three queued barrels needed for brewing.
Inspect the still and its available brewing jobs.
Queue plant brewing at the still and enable repeat.
Open plant-gathering designations to supply food and repeat brewing.
Designate a broad patch of surface plants for gathering to supply food and brewing.
Open downward-stair designation to begin an underground shelter.
Designate an entrance stair near the wagon and its connecting stair one level below.
Excavate a first underground room west of the stairs, then let the miners work.
Let the miner finish excavating the underground room before placing farms and beds.
Open farm plot placement in the excavated underground room.
Place a small underground farm plot in the excavated soil room.
Allow dwarves to construct the newly placed 3×3 farm plot.
Inspect the completed farm plot and its crop settings.
Allow dwarves time to construct the farm plot.
Inspect the farm construction and its labor requirements.
Open the citizens list to assign a farmer for the unfinished plot.
Open Udib's labor settings to assign farming.
Return to the citizen list to access labor controls.
Locate Udib and open native labor preferences to enable farming.
Open Udib's farming labor settings to enable field work.
Select Farming/Related using the labor menu's list navigation.
Enable Udib's Farming (Fields) labor so the farm can be constructed and planted.
Farming is now enabled for Udib; leave the labor submenu to resume farm construction.
Leave the labor menu and allow the farmer time to construct the farm plot.
Inspect the underground farm after allowing construction time.
Move the building query cursor onto the underground farm to inspect its construction and crop settings.
Set the completed farm to grow plump helmets in every season, then let dwarves plant.
Check that the farm is assigned plump helmets before establishing sleeping quarters.
Move the building-query cursor onto the farm to inspect crop settings.
Set plump helmets for every season and begin placing underground beds.
Place the first bed and inspect the material selection.
Select the first bed for placement at (16,16).
Place a second bed beside the first.
Place the remaining five beds and allow construction and farming to proceed.
Inspect a completed bed to establish a shared dormitory.
Define a shared sleeping room around the installed beds.
Expand the bedroom to cover the beds, confirm it, and enable a communal dormitory.
Verify food and drink reserves after confirming the dormitory is enabled.
Return to the fortress and allow farming and hauling to progress.
Let the farmer sow and grow crops while the fortress completes queued work.
Inspect surface workshops to prepare dining furniture and brewing.
Open the carpenter's task menu to produce dining furniture.
Queue three tables and three chairs, then allow carpentry and farming to proceed.
Start placing dining tables underground.
Inspect carpenter jobs because no finished tables are available.
Select the carpenter's workshop and inspect its job queue.
Let dwarves finish the queued tables and chairs and tend crops.
Select a table for the underground dining area.
Inspect the carpenter's workshop to find why no tables are available.
Leave the build menu and inspect the carpenter's workshop queue.
Resume the fortress so the carpenter can finish queued dining furniture and crops can grow.
Check whether the carpenter has completed the queued dining furniture.
Inspect citizens and current jobs to identify why the carpentry queue has not progressed.
Inspect Urvad's labor settings to enable carpentry for the pending furniture jobs.
Return from Urvad's overview to locate labor controls.
Open Urvad's unit preferences to assign carpentry labor.
Open Urvad's woodworking labors to assign carpentry.
Enable Urvad's Carpentry labor so the queued tables and chairs can be made.
Resume so the newly enabled carpenter can produce dining furniture and farmers can tend crops.
Begin placing a dining table and inspect available furniture.
Place the first dining table underground near the dormitory.
Confirm the willow table and allow construction and furniture production to proceed.
Place a chair beside the completed dining table.
Allow queued furniture production and farming to progress; no chair is available yet.
Check whether a finished wooden chair is available for the dining area.
Resume the simulation so carpentry and farming jobs can finish.
Check whether a wooden chair is now available to place beside the dining table.
Move chair placement beside the table and select a chair.
Confirm the chair beside the table, then inspect the table's room controls.
Define a dining room from the completed table.
Confirm the dining room and let construction and farming progress.
Let farming, gathering, and furniture production continue.
Let farming and furniture production progress into Felsite.
Inspect the farm's planting status while most dwarves are idle.
Set plump helmets for every season and allow farming and furniture production to proceed.
Inspect the farm's crop settings and planting status.
Assign plump helmets to the farm for all seasons and allow planting to proceed.
Inspect the farm's crop assignment and planting status.
Assign plump helmets in every season and let farmers work.
Allow planting and workshop production to continue.
Let planting and harvesting continue so the farm can supply brewing ingredients.
Check food and drink reserves after the farm's recent activity.
Return to fortress view to restart brewing with the increased plant supply.
Move to the surface and inspect the still to restart brewing.
Select the still and inspect available brewing tasks.
Queue repeating plant brewing and let farming and brewing proceed.
Inspect the still to verify the repeating brewing job remains active.
Let the active repeating brewing job and farm work proceed.
Let farming and repeating brewing continue toward summer.
Let farming and repeating brewing continue toward summer.
Inspect the carpenter to make more barrels; brewing has stopped for lack of empty food storage.
